title: Quality of Worlds
description: This project is a Quality of Life modpack, adding features that just make vanilla Minecraft better
body: This modpack is simple: it adds quality of life features to Minecraft like smooth mouse transitions, vein minining, timber, schematics, and more. It does not add any new items, blocks, structures, or mods to the game, it simply allows the base game to do its thing while making it easier to do some game mechanics.
